mainEntity.name: Do I need a lawyer if the delivery company's insurance offers a settlement?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is highly recommended to consult with a delivery injury lawyer even if an insurance company offers a settlement. Insurance adjusters represent the interests of their company, not yours, and their initial offers are often lower than the true value of your claim. A lawyer can evaluate the offer against your medical expenses, lost income, and future needs, ensuring you don't accept an inadequate amount. They can also negotiate on your behalf to secure a fair settlement that fully compensates you for all your damages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Even with a settlement offer, consulting a delivery injury lawyer is wise, as initial offers from insurance companies are often low and may not cover all your damages.
